title: Password Spray Investigation Playbook
scope: Microsoft Learn published password spray investigation workflow across Microsoft Entra ID and M365 sign-in telemetry.

source.license_or_reuse: Microsoft Learn terms apply; retain attribution and source link.

prerequisites.requirement: Microsoft Entra ID sign-in logs and risk detections enabled
prerequisites.required_capability: Entra ID P1/P2 or SIEM sign-in ingestion

steps.activity: Identify password spray indicators and source infrastructure
steps.description: Identify clustered failed authentication attempts across multiple accounts from a common IP, ASN, or legacy protocol.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Identify spike in failed sign-ins across multiple user accounts.

normalization_notes: Working extraction aligned to Microsoft Learn Password Spray guidance.

steps.activity: Evaluate targeted accounts for successful sign-ins and session compromise
steps.description: Determine whether any targeted user account experienced a successful authentication or MFA bypass from the suspicious infrastructure.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Check whether any targeted accounts had a successful sign-in.

steps.activity: Correlate IP reputation, user-agent, and post-authentication activity
steps.description: Inspect proxy/VPN/anonymizer usage, client user-agent anomalies, and directory/mailbox changes after login.

source_anchor.section: Workflow; Review sign-in telemetry and post-compromise activity
source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Evaluate IP reputation, user agent, and subsequent directory activity.

steps.activity: Contain compromised identities and enforce credential reset
steps.description: Revoke active refresh tokens, reset credentials, and block malicious source IPs when account compromise is confirmed.
steps.condition: When >=1 targeted account exhibits successful logon or token abuse.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Reset passwords, revoke active sessions, and apply Conditional Access blocks.

steps.activity: Document authentication investigation disposition and close incident
steps.description: Record verified spray scope, affected identities, and hardening recommendations.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Document investigation findings and close the incident.

completion_criteria: Targeted account scope and failed sign-in volume documented
Threat intelligence and user-agent enrichment recorded
Containment or benign closure rationale documented

normalization.method: Structured extraction from Microsoft Learn Password Spray Investigation Playbook headings
notes: Normalized to Action Schema to enable multi-playbook password spraying conformance comparison alongside PB-SPRAY-001.
